notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or removal date appears in any source read. The Forest Lookouts entry is one line. A search snippet cites a 1950s metal cabin and a table last updated in 2011; the cited lo-arizona page returned HTTP 404 and the snippet was never verified, so it is not used. The SummitPost page describes the mountain, not the lookout. The next check is a Sitgreaves or Apache-Sitgreaves district record. The story is short because the evidence is thin.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts files the site under the Sitgreaves National Forest (land description 8N-27E-11); SummitPost says the mountain is on Arizona State Lands, which requires a permit. The story attributes each source and does not pick one.
